read_ifps.py.content_utf8:
import inspect
from pathlib import Path
from refinery.lib.inno.archive import InnoArchive
from refinery.lib.inno import ifps
import sys
data=Path(sys.argv[1]).read_bytes()
print("Inno signature",inspect.signature(InnoArchive))
print("Inno APIs",[n for n in dir(InnoArchive) if "script" in n.lower() or "ifps" in n.lower()])
print("IFPS APIs",[n for n in dir(ifps) if "script" in n.lower() or "ifps" in n.lower()])
app=InnoArchive(data)
for name in ("ifps","script","get_ifps","get_script","compiled_code","get_compiled_script"):
    item=getattr(app,name,None)
    if item is None:continue
    value=item() if callable(item) else item
    if isinstance(value,(bytes,bytearray,memoryview)):
        value=ifps.IFPSFile(value)
    for method in ("disassembly","disassemble","dump"):
        fn=getattr(value,method,None)
        if fn is not None:
            d=fn() if callable(fn) else fn
            if not isinstance(d,(str,bytes)): d="\n".join(map(str,d))
            print(d)
            break
